title: Evidence Before Expansion: Reuse, Spawn, or Defer in Lifelong Expert Pools
abstract: arXiv:2608.19888v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming systems that maintain a pool of expert models must repeatedly decide whether to reuse an existing expert for arriving data, spawn a new one, or defer. We present a decision layer that makes all three outcomes statistically meaningful. Reuse and spawn are posed as one-sided sequential hypotheses on a conditional (mechanism-level) discrepancy, separated by an indifference zone; defer is exactly the state in which neither betting e-process has accumulated sufficient evidence. We prove finite-time anytime validity for the observable surrogate discrepancy of a predictable discriminator sequence, and an unconditional one-sided transfer to the population quantity in which each side's slack is the excess risk of a single discriminator; an empirically observed downward-bias regularity makes the spawn side exactly conservative. Recency without sacrificing the guarantee is obtained by a restarted e-detector: a bank of unwindowed betting

translated_title: 扩展前的证据：终身专家池中的重用、生成或推迟
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.19888v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：维护专家模型池的流式系统必须反复决定是否对到达的数据重用现有专家、生成新专家或推迟决策。我们提出了一个决策层，使这三种结果都具有统计意义。重用和生成被表述为基于条件（机制级）差异的单侧序列假设，并通过一个无差别区间分隔；推迟则是在两个投注e-process均未积累足够证据时的状态。我们证明了可预测判别器序列的可观测替代差异的有限时间随时有效性，以及到总体量的无条件单侧转移，其中每侧的松弛度是单个判别器的超额风险；经验观察到的向下偏差规律使生成侧恰好保守。通过重启的e检测器获得不牺牲保证的时效性：一组无窗口投注。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于统计假设检验的决策层，使流式专家池在重用、生成或推迟三种操作之间做出有理论保证的选择，并证明了其有限时间有效性和保守性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a statistically principled decision layer for streaming expert pools, enabling reuse, spawn, or defer choices with finite-time validity and conservativeness guarantees.
